profile.headline: Software engineer - Java
profile.summary:
Software engineer with experience of over 18 years developing J2EE systems, working on enterprise and web application for a variety of business such as government agencies, financial, human resources, network management, mobile phone companies, and banks. Using Java, JSP, Hibernate, Spring MVC, Spring Boot, HTML, JavaScript, AngularJS, JQuery and SQL among other technologies.
I like to solve problems and help others to achieve common goals, always looking to use new technologies while exercising best code practices and be engaged in every phase of the development lifecycle.
